summary: H.R. 6190, titled the "Tax Cuts for Veterans Act of 2025," amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exclude all military retirement pay and related benefits from federal income tax. The bill modifies rules regarding gross income for members and former members of the Armed Forces and uniformed services, repeals certain existing code sections related to retirement pay, and applies these changes to taxable years beginning after the date of enactment.

affected_groups.effect: Their military retirement and related disability, combat injury, or death benefits are excluded from federal income tax.
affected_groups.group: Members and former members of the Armed Forces

affected_groups.effect: Their reduced retirement pay and related contract considerations are handled under specific rules that exclude certain amounts from gross income.
affected_groups.group: Members and former members of the uniformed services other than the Armed Forces

key_provisions: Excludes retired or retainer pay paid under title 10 or 14 of the U.S. Code from gross income for members or former members of the Armed Forces.
Excludes monthly compensation, pensions, pay, annuities, or allowances received in connection with a disability, combat-related injury, disability, or death from gross income.
Excludes certain reduced uniformed services retirement pay from gross income for members of the uniformed services other than the Armed Forces.
Repeals section 1403 of title 10, United States Code.
Applies the tax amendments to taxable years beginning after the date of the Act's enactment.
